She further states that she has three children out of the wedlock with the applicant, eldest of whom is a son aged 17 years old.

5. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the opposite party no.2, the alleged victim of the offence committed by the applicant, had married the applicant on 20.09.2005 i.e even prior to lodging of the F.I.R and she is continuously living with the applicant as his wife and has delivered three children out of the wedlock, the eldest of whom is 17 years old, the continuance of the criminal proceedings against the applicant would not in any manner serves the interest of justice.

6. Accordingly, the application is allowed and the Charge sheet dated 17.11.2007 along with the entire criminal proceedings of the case crime no. 341/2005, ' State Vs. Dilip Kumar Pandey', under section 376 I.P.C, Police Station Kotwali Tanda, District Ambedkar Nagar are hereby quashed.
